22. Journeys Tasks with External URL
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Checklist Templates.
Search for Leave of Absence.
Open the checklist template.
Click Tasks.
For every task with Task Type equal to External URL, open the task.
Locate the URL field in the middle section of the task configuration page.
Update the environment-specific portion of the URL.
Keep the base URL unchanged.
Click Save and Close.
Repeat for all external URL tasks.
Repeat for Medical Leave Journey and Leave Extension templates.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
